name: browser-use
headline: Byterover Claude and Codex workflow
short_description: Automates AI-to-AI code review by bridging Claude Code and Codex CLI through Byterover shared memory, eliminating manual context switching and enabling continuous architectural validation.
author: trietdeptrai

sections.overview:
This skill enables seamless collaboration between Claude Code and Codex CLI by using Byterover as a persistent shared memory layer. Claude automatically creates architectural plans, invokes Codex for expert review via Bash, retrieves feedback, and implements improvements—all without manual intervention or context switching. The workflow handles planning, automated review cycles, and optional validation in a continuous pipeline that typically completes in 5-10 minutes. Developers benefit from expert-level code review integrated directly into their AI agent workflow, catching architectural issues early and avoiding repeated mistakes across projects. This eliminates the traditional friction of manually copying context between tools.
Automated architectural review before implementation
Rate limiting and authentication system design
Code quality validation with expert feedback integration
Performance-critical feature implementation with dual-agent review
